head: 52d4b79e048b1c982ac0d24c11f92df004e3600d
claim: Pi consumers can use Ollama Pro through the existing OpenAI-compatible provider shape, preserving its Ollama endpoint and using the model they selected.

steps.start: Ollama Pro plan key is available in an in-memory fixture store.
steps: Resolve the Ollama Pro catalogue shape and plan-key route.
Send the selected model through built @byokit/accounts with a fixture transport.
Observe the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, model id, and credential header.
steps.result: The request reached https://ollama.com/v1/chat/completions with deepseek-v4.1-flash and returned shape-ok.

verdicts.seen: I read the one capture entry. It shows providerShape "openai", routeId "ollama-pro:plan_key", endpoint "https://ollama.com/v1/chat/completions", selectedModel "deepseek-v4.1-flash", authPresent true, response text "shape-ok", and stopReason "stop". This matches the outcome: an OpenAI-compatible shape, the Ollama endpoint preserved, the user's selected model used, and a successful completion. The outcome names a single part, so parts is empty.
